goal: acceptance gate: the independent 11 kHz sampling throughput bench must be re-run for the current version, and recorded separately from the whole-vehicle run that actually triggers about 7.59 kHz at 10 km/h
why_a_rerun_was_owed: the passing bench on record was produced on 2026-09-10 by commit a3304b0. linescan.yaml changed after it, in 9bcfc49 "Fix encoder retrace triggering" -- a change to trigger logic, which is exactly what a line-rate bench measures. The gate asks for the new version, so the old figure could not stand in for it.
verdict: passed on the current version: 11199.98 sustained lines per wall second against an 11200 target, 144 of 144 blocks acknowledged over ROS, zero invalid pixels, and both delay budgets met

what_improved.note: headroom rather than delivered rate: the sustained rate is pinned to the 11200 target. The batch worst case fell from 18.5 to 12.8 ms against a 22.9 ms budget, and device allocation fell by 446 MB after the acceleration-structure retention work

scope: a fixture path with a body and LED rig, no wheel dynamics and no GZ physics
instant direction reversal at the path ends, with no warmup excluded
the OS file cache may be warm
this does not substitute for, and is not substituted by, the whole-vehicle run at 10 km/h which triggers about 7.59 kHz
